NDVI Monitoring for Para Brazil

---
{r}
# -----------------------------
# 0. Install required packages
# -----------------------------
if(!requireNamespace("MODISTools", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("MODISTools")
if(!requireNamespace("tidyverse", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("tidyverse")
if(!requireNamespace("sf", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("sf")
if(!requireNamespace("future.apply", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("future.apply")
if(!requireNamespace("here", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("here")

# -----------------------------
# 1. Load libraries
# -----------------------------
library(MODISTools)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(future.apply)
library(here)

# -----------------------------
# 2. Define Pará bounding box
# -----------------------------
para_bbox <- st_bbox(c(xmin = -55, xmax = -45, ymin = -5, ymax = 2), crs = 4326)

# Create a grid of points (0.25° spacing; ~1189 points)
lon_seq <- seq(para_bbox$xmin, para_bbox$xmax, by = 0.25)
lat_seq <- seq(para_bbox$ymin, para_bbox$ymax, by = 0.25)
pts <- expand.grid(lon = lon_seq, lat = lat_seq)

# -----------------------------
# 3. Setup parallel plan
# -----------------------------
library(future)
plan(multisession, workers = parallel::detectCores() - 1)  # leave one core free

# -----------------------------
# 4. Download NDVI in parallel
# -----------------------------
download_point <- function(i) {
  cat("Downloading point", i, "of", nrow(pts), "\n")
  temp <- try(
    MODISTools::mt_subset(
      product = "MOD13Q1",
      lat = pts$lat[i],
      lon = pts$lon[i],
      band = "250m_16_days_NDVI",
      start = "2000-01-01",   # <--- changed
      end = "2025-01-01",     # <--- changed
      km_lr = 0,
      km_ab = 0,
      site_name = paste0("Point_", i),
      internal = TRUE
    ), silent = TRUE
  )
 
  if(!inherits(temp, "try-error")) return(temp)
  else return(NULL)
}

ndvi_list <- future_lapply(1:nrow(pts), download_point)
ndvi_data <- bind_rows(ndvi_list)

# -----------------------------
# 5. Scale NDVI
# -----------------------------
ndvi_data <- ndvi_data %>%
  mutate(value = value / 10000)

# -----------------------------
# 6. Classify NDVI
# -----------------------------
ndvi_data <- ndvi_data %>%
  mutate(class = case_when(
    value < 0 ~ "water/shadow/snow",
    value >= 0 & value < 0.2 ~ "bare soil / urban",
    value >= 0.2 & value < 0.5 ~ "sparse vegetation",
    value >= 0.5 ~ "dense vegetation"
  ))

# -----------------------------
# 7. Summarize by date
# -----------------------------
ndvi_summary <- ndvi_data %>%
  group_by(calendar_date, class) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(calendar_date) %>%
  mutate(percent = count / sum(count) * 100)

# -----------------------------
# 8. Plot time series
# -----------------------------
ggplot(ndvi_summary, aes(x = as.Date(calendar_date), y = percent, color = class)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "NDVI Class Distribution Over Time - Pará, Brazil (2000–2025)",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Percentage (%)",
    color = "NDVI Class"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
